DHI.src: SEC EDGAR 10-K 분기 실적 주석·10-Q (원문에서 옮김, 2026-11-05)
DHI.note: Revenue = total consolidated revenues as shown in each 10-K 'Quarterly Results of Operations (Unaudited)' note (= Homebuilding revenues [home sales + land/lot sales (and other)] + Financial Services revenues; the income statement has no single 'total revenues' line, verified e.g. FY1999 Q2 10-Q 690.600+8.481=699.081, FY2013 Q1 1,233.2+41.9=1,275.1). Revenue for each quarter taken from the following fiscal year's 10-K (latest filing showing it); FY1999-FY2003 values are in thousands in those filings and rounded to $0.1M. Pre-tax = consolidated 'Income (loss) before income taxes' (sum of homebuilding and financial services pre-tax; DHI reported no discontinued operations; no separate noncontrolling-interest line affects it). FY2007 Q1 to FY2013 Q1 (2006-12-31 to 2012-12-31): taken directly from the 10-K quarterly note of the following fiscal year (FY2008 10-K onward include pre-tax in that note). FY1999 Q2 to FY2006 Q3: 10-K quarterly notes (FY1999-FY2007 10-Ks) do NOT show pre-tax, so taken from 10-Q three-month columns, using the prior-year comparative column of the next year's 10-Q (latest); these equal the originally reported values in all cases checked. Q4 (Sep quarters) FY1999-FY2006 are DERIVED: full-year pre-tax from 10-K minus nine-month pre-tax from the 10-Q (FY1999 263.826-182.196; FY2000 309.224-209.731; FY2001 407.797-268.975; FY2002 647.507-429.278; FY2003 1,008.162-636.021; FY2004 1,582.9-1,017.019; FY2005 2,378.6-1,474.2; FY2006 1,987.1-1,541.3); possible +/-0.1

NVR.src: SEC EDGAR 10-K 분기 실적 주석·10-Q (원문에서 옮김, 2026-11-05)
NVR.note: Revenue = 'Revenues-homebuilding operations' + 'Mortgage banking fees' taken from the 'Quarterly Results (unaudited)' note of the FOLLOWING year's 10-K (latest presentation; e.g. 2012 quarters from FY2013 10-K); all 4-quarter homebuilding sums tie exactly to annual 10-K income statements. NVR's quarterly note does not show pre-tax income, so pre-tax for Q1-Q3 = three-month 'Income before taxes' (1999-2003 labelled 'Total segment income', which is consolidated income before income taxes per the segment reconciliation) from each quarter's 10-Q; values verified identical to prior-year comparative columns in the next year's 10-Qs (no restatement), and Q1+Q2+Q3 tie to the 10-Q nine-month column. Q4 pre-tax = full-year income before taxes (latest 10-K) minus Q1-Q3 (derived). Source field: first URL = 10-K with quarterly note (revenue); second URL (after ' ; ') = 10-Q (Q1-Q3 pre-tax) or FY 10-K (Q4 pre-tax). Restatements/reclasses: FY2000 mortgage banking fees were reclassified in the FY2001 10-K (quarterly 7,963/9,175/10,147/10,659 = $37.9M vs originally 7,597/7,622/12,950/10,588 = $38.8M); restated values used. FY1999 annual mortgage fees were later reclassified to $48,165K (FY2001 10-K) vs $48,122K in quarterly note; no restated quarterly split exists, so FY2000 10-K quarterly 1999 figures used ($43K annual gap, immaterial). TOL.src: SEC EDGAR 10-K 분기 실적 주석·10-Q (원문에서 옮김, 2026-11-05)
TOL.note: All values from the 'Summary Consolidated Quarterly Financial Data (Unaudited)' note of the latest 10-K (or 10-K/A) presenting each fiscal year (each 10-K shows 2 years); source URL = that filing. Every fiscal year's 4 quarters tie to the annual income statement (revenue exact; pretax exact, FY2012 within rounding of 112.9M). REVENUE DEFINITION BREAKS (as reported, latest presentation): (a) FY1999-FY2003: 'Revenues' = home sales + land sales + equity earnings in unconsolidated JVs + interest and other (old income statement total; e.g. FY2003 total 2,775.2M vs home+land 2,758.4M). Not restated quarterly in any later filing. (b) FY2004-FY2007: revenues = home sales (completed contract + percentage-of-completion from FY2006) + land sales; FY2004 quarters are the restated figures from the FY2005 10-K, which moved equity earnings and interest/other below operating income (FY2004 total 3,861.9M vs 3,893.1M originally). (c) FY2008-FY2012: revenues = home sales only; FY2009 10-K reclassified land sales into other income, and FY2008 quarters are the restated figures from the FY2009 10-K (FY2008 total 3,148.2M vs 3,158.2M originally). FY2007/FY2006 quarters were never restated quarterly (later selected data show FY2007 4,635.1M and FY2006 6,115.3M ex-land vs 4,647.0M/6,123.5M in this series); land sales were ~0.2-1% of revenue. Pretax: FY1999 line is 'Income before income taxes and extraordinary loss' (extraordinary loss on debt was below tax line, so this is pretax income). FY2006 Q4
